profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Applications Development Lead | Full-Stack & Platform Engineering | Technical Leadership
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of full-stack development experience across front-end technologies (TypeScript, React, JavaScript, Responsive Design) and back-end technologies (PHP, Symfony, RESTful APIs, MySQL), with deep specialization in enterprise CMS architecture (Drupal, eZ Publish, SDL Tridion). Proven track record leading development teams, modernizing legacy systems, and delivering secure, scalable platforms across federal government, healthcare, financial services, and media. Holds a current Public Trust, Tier 2 determination and previously held a DoD Secret Clearance. Combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, code review, and Agile/Scrum delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States  · Remote
positions.description:
• Drupal Lead Developer for the Office of Head Start (OHS) — a federal program supporting school readiness for low-income children — serving as a government contractor with Public Trust clearance
• Led development on HeadStart.gov, the program's bilingual (English/Spanish) website, streamlining content publishing for editorial staff and strengthening the program's public-facing presence across its national network of grantees and families
• Ensured Section 508 compliance on HeadStart.gov by implementing WCAG standards via the USWDS toolkit, improving usability for Head Start users nationwide
• Integrated Claude Code into the development workflow, reducing turnaround time and improving code quality.
• Migrated legacy applications (i.e. Tomcat/JSP applications) to custom Drupal modules and engineered custom REST APIs to integrate with upstream systems
• Managed a team of junior developers, overseeing task delegation, code reviews, and alignment with company goals
• Led the effort to migrate a production Drupal site to Drupal 11, resolving deprecated code and module incompatibilities to keep the site on a supported, secure release track
positions.insights: Skills: Drupal · Public Trust Clearance · Agile Methodologies · Project Management · Full LAMP Stack Development · Linux · Apache · MySQL · PHP · jQuery · Responsive Web Design · Jenkins · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Node.js · RESTful WebServices · REST APIs · PhpStorm · Symfony · Nginx · Scrum · Twig (Template Engine) · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · CSS/Sass · Drush · TypeScript · AngularJS · Google Analytics · Government

positions.title: Lead Drupal Developer / Security Lead
positions.description:
• Horizon BCBS is New Jersey's largest health insurer, serving 3.7M+ members
• Led the development of HIPAA-compliant Drupal 8 and 7 websites, ensuring security and functionality
• Conducted a technical evaluation of Acquia Cloud for the Horizon Drupal platform, including hands-on platform review and analysis of hosting architecture, legacy-system integration, security, operational complexity, and cost; delivered a written recommendation to management
• Authored custom modules and scripts for data encryption and user forms, enhancing system interfaces
• Directed and mentored an offshore development team, promoting application design and security awareness and adhering to change and release management specifications
